name: Adani proposed Odisha AI data centre, tentative Cuttack location
notes: ETDatacenters/Business Standard report says Adani proposed a Rs 1 trillion AI data centre in Odisha, requested about 250 acres, and the proposal is under state evaluation; officials said a tentative location could be Cuttack but has not been finalised. Capacity not disclosed in the cited article.
